commercial_rule: Capabilities are cataloged separately from payment activation. No capability becomes checkout-enabled without an explicit approval gate and a canonical economic object.

capabilities.name: BEC-PRIME Architecture
capabilities.summary: Four-layer local-first commerce architecture spanning Foundation, Canonical, Execution, and Surface.

capabilities.name: CUBE Compiler / Reskin / Clone / Silo
capabilities.summary: A planned compiler architecture for producing controlled surfaces from canonical economic and asset definitions while preserving silo boundaries.

capabilities.name: Elohim Refinery
capabilities.summary: The planned orchestration/refinery layer for turning validated specifications and signals into executable work.

capabilities.name: Gauntlet
capabilities.summary: A rule-driven verification layer for approval gates, canonical products, settlement-before-delivery, idempotency, proof generation, silo isolation, and deterministic verification.

capabilities.name: Truth and Proof Engine
capabilities.summary: Evidence-first transaction and system-state verification that distinguishes designed, implemented, verified, deployed, and proven states.

capabilities.name: Revenue OS
capabilities.summary: A closed economic loop connecting discovery, pain clustering, SKU creation, exposure, conversion, fulfillment, feedback, red-team checks, and ledger evidence.

capabilities.name: Commerce Kernel
capabilities.summary: A payment-rail-agnostic economic execution model separating offer, payment intent, authorization, settlement, delivery, and proof.

capabilities.name: Agentic Commerce Layer
capabilities.summary: Machine-readable paid capabilities designed for future agent commerce, with x402 deliberately held in backlog until first commercial proof.

capabilities.name: Silo and Asset Control
capabilities.summary: Explicit tenant, owner, asset, and silo boundaries preventing cross-pollination between MTG, commerce, and adult/Amplissa domains.

capabilities.name: Commercial Proof Loop
capabilities.summary: Customer to payment to verified settlement to delivery to durable proof, with FIRST_PAYMENT_PROOF.json as the first commercial evidence gate.
